script_text: Pisces, this week Neptune, your ruling planet, ignites your 2nd House of money, and nothing looks the same afterward. Early week the Sun finishes Scorpio through your 9th House while Saturn in your 1st House squares it. Monday and Tuesday feel heavy, emotionally drained, tense with an authority figure who wants answers. Wednesday is the turning point: the Sun enters Sagittarius, your 10th House, and squares Saturn, forcing one hard conversation that earns you the title. Thursday the Sun trines Neptune while Venus softens your 7th House of partnership, turning a contract talk into romance. Jupiter in Leo, your 6th House, keeps the weekend busy, so Sunday is for quiet water and rest. Best day: Thursday, the trine lands in your money house. Worst day: Wednesday, the Sun-Saturn square peaks. Water sign advice: trust the fog, sign nothing before Friday arrives. Follow for daily updates.
